mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ASYNC_TASK_DISPATCH (TASK_ID, DEPARTMENT, TRACE_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{department}, #{traceId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT LAST_TENANT FROM ASYNC_TASK_DISPATCH_LOCK WHERE DELETED=0 AND (LOCK_ID=1) FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASYNC_TASK t JOIN ASYNC_TASK_DISPATCH d ON t.TASK_ID=d.TASK_ID WHERE t.DELETED=0 AND d.DELETED=0 AND (t.STATUS IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') AND t.LEASE_EXPIRES_AT>#{leaseExpiresAt})

SELECT t.TASK_ID FROM ASYNC_TASK t JOIN ASYNC_TASK_DISPATCH d ON t.TASK_ID=d.TASK_ID WHERE t.DELETED=0 AND d.DELETED=0 AND (t.STATUS IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') AND (t.KIND NOT LIKE 'agent.readonly.%.v2' OR #{checkpointVersion}=1) AND (t.LEASE_EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR t.LEASE_EXPIRES_AT<=#{leaseExpiresAt}) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASYNC_TASK b JOIN ASYNC_TASK_DISPATCH bd ON b.TASK_ID=bd.TASK_ID WHERE b.DELETED=0 AND bd.DELETED=0 AND b.TENANT_ID=t.TENANT_ID AND b.STATUS IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') AND b.LEASE_EXPIRES_AT>#{leaseExpiresAt2}) < #{limit}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.TENANT_ID>#{tenantId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.TENANT_ID, t.CREATED_AT, t.TASK_ID LIMIT 1
